# `cycle.record`

Record one host-attested source outcome after durable import. Success requires exhaustive paging; incomplete results never advance a successful fetch checkpoint.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice cycle-record`
- **MCP tool:** `cycle_record` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | `str` | required |  |
| `integration` | `str` | required |  |
| `outcome` | `str` | required |  |
| `counts` | `json` | optional, default=None | Fetched/imported/duplicates/filtered/pages counts |
| `checkpoint` | `json` | optional, default=None | Opaque private provider continuation, never text |

## Examples

```
operator-voice cycle-record --run-id '<run_id>' --integration '<integration>' --outcome '<outcome>'
```
